主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. (CLB US) announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.55 per share of common stock, payable in the third quarter of 2015. The dividend, payable on August 17, 2015, will be distributed to shareholders of record on July 17, 2015, with a Dutch withholding tax of 15% applied. The company stated that future dividend decisions will depend on financial position, earnings, earnings outlook, capital expenditure plans, share repurchases, and potential acquisitions. Core Laboratories N.V. is a leading provider of reservoir description and production enhancement services in the energy sector, operating in over 50 countries.
